title: H3 All In One
description: Every MiniMax H3 job in one workflow: reference mode, first and last frame, keyframes built by Qwen Image Edit, a voice track, an optional SeedVR2 upscale to 1080 and RIFE smooth motion.
pick_when: The MiniMax H3 default: most video shots, a new scene from words or references, with sound and dialogue, 3-15 s; a shot that starts on a picture; lips that follow a voice track; a product ad from keyframes. H3 Chunk is the second option, for a scene clip that needs its anchor, more than three characters or shot keyframes.

hints: Reference mode builds a new scene from your references; first-frame mode keeps the first frame exactly and takes no other references: then describe only motion and camera.
Best results come from 5-6 s clips, one action each. Durations from 3 to 15 s work.

Quality: medium at 480p looks close to high at about half the time, for drafts and look tests; low can add people or effects nobody asked for. A final take where hands pass things or a ball is in play: high at 720p.
Prompt blocks, short: GOAL · SCENE · OPENING · SHOTS timed '[0-2s] size, lens, angle → one action → dialogue → move' · STYLE · END STATE · LOCKS. No shape or length words.
For speech write who says what, in quotes, in the beat it is said: the old man says: "Sign here." With a VOICE TRACK the lips follow your own audio. A silent clip says 'No dialogue. No music.'
Identity in words: age, build, the features that tell them apart; the same words every clip. No negative prompt: put short 'No ...' lines in LOCKS.
For a 1080 final, use Resolution 720 with Upscale video on: H3 renders at its native 1344x768 and SeedVR2 upscales it to 1920x1080. Resolution 1080 is above H3's training size: slower, more warping.
Upscale video goes to 1080 on the short edge only: 1440 filled the GPU and looked no sharper. Best upscale (7B) stays closer to the source; Fast (3B) is about 10% quicker.
Smooth motion (RIFE) saves the video at 48 fps; without it the video is 24 fps.

checks.message: Sharpen first frame needs a first frame: add a picture in FIRST FRAME, or build the opening frame (Keyframes).
Keep my voice track needs a VOICE TRACK: add one, or pick another Sound.
Building the opening frame needs a picture in KEYFRAME BUILDER: PRODUCT / SUBJECT IMAGE.
Building the end frame needs the opening frame built too.
